Include the leave-one-benchmark-out representative row from selected_extra.csv if it fits. I will cite it as Table 10 in an appendix section; tell me the file name and what it shows. Also (minor, not blocking): in Figure 4 the legend squeezes the panels (review n3); a legend above or below would give the panels their width.
